content:
anya: FYI repro for sampleapp: prefetch window stalls when token refresh happens mid-prefetch. Using JS SDK v0.26.1, prefetchConcurrency=3, tokenRefreshSync=true.

anya: Repro logs: 
```
prefetch: fetch(page=2) waiting on auth refresh
auth: refresh started
prefetch: blocked on auth mutex
http: 401 -> queued retry
```

sam: That looks like the refresh path holds a global lock. We had a Go fix earlier; JS may still have the issue.

jing: Can you confirm sampleapp config and whether prefetch uses shared token?

anya: Default sampleapp config. Prefetch grabs token from auth module which uses a sync refresh when expired.

tyler: tokenRefreshSync=true blocks callers while it refreshes. If all prefetch slots block you stall the pipeline. Workaround: set tokenRefreshSync=false so refresh is async.

anya: Setting async avoids deadlock but causes ~1% more 401 retries.

sam: Proposed SDK changes: (1) snapshot token per prefetch batch, (2) do async refresh without holding prefetch lock, (3) add prefetchRetryWindowMs and metric prefetch.auth_retries.

jing: Also add small jitter to prefetch starts to avoid thundering herd. Need parity across JS and Go.

tyler: Quick JS prototype:
```
const token = auth.getTokenSnapshot();
await fetchPage(page, { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` });
auth.refreshIfNeeded().catch(()=>{});
```

tyler: Local tests: no deadlock, pages delivered. 401 rate increased from 0.5% to ~1.1% but acceptable if opt-in.

sam: Make optimistic prefetch opt-in (allowOptimisticPrefetch=false by default), add telemetry and changelog.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started for branch "prefetch-optimistic-2026" (deploy id: d-7982).

jing: Please open PR with unit tests that simulate token expiry mid-window and deterministic fake-clock for jitter. I will review.

anya: Will do; updating quickstart note to recommend tokenRefreshSync=false for sampleapp until parity lands. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
